answer: An agent economy can plant an orchard of stakes: each identity must lock a deposit before transacting, and payouts stay proportional to stake plus attested work. The ledger keeps crystal-clear provenance, so every clone maps back to one funding root and gets burned together. Meanwhile karst audits — random sinkhole probes demanding fresh proof of recent useful work — swallow identities that cannot answer, forfeiting their stake. An attacker must then fund a separate real deposit per fake and keep each one working, turning a thousand sockpuppets from free into a thousand funded farms.
